svg.title: Willamette Valley (OR) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Willamette Valley; 2: McMinnville; 3: Newberg; 4: Dundee; 5: Carlton; 6: Amity; 7: Portland; 8: Vancouver; 9: Eugene; 10: Corvallis; 11: Albany; 12: Springfield

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
